readiness.summary: T10 can be dispatched after T08 lands, provided the native claim-block seam is assigned before implementation. The current inspector already selects the oldest completed sprint without a regular retrospective and treats directories, FIFOs and symlinks as unreadable rather than completed records.

required_choices.recommendation: Pin the next-claim veto in T08's owned current-pm.mjs caller seam, or authorize a separate bounded current-pm correction. T10 cannot satisfy the approved missing-retrospective claim block through its frozen touches. The check should consume inspectProjectState().sprints_without_retro and fail before a new claim; resume of an existing claim should remain distinct.

Export prepareRetrospective(root,{sprint?,structuralPaths?}) and recordRetrospective(root,{sprint,expectedPreparationHash,review,submission}). Use `retro.mjs prepare [--sprint N] [--structural-paths FILE]` and `retro.mjs record --sprint N --expected-preparation HASH --review FILE --submission FILE`. All input files must be bounded canonical regular files. Prepare is read-only; record recomputes the preparation and writes only docs/retros/sprint-N.md.

Return versioned states READY, SKIPPED, ALREADY_RECORDED and UNKNOWN. Incomplete or out-of-order requested sprints fail without mutation. UNKNOWN is an inspectable non-success state and cannot be recorded. An explicit newer sprint must refuse while an older completed sprint is missing its record.

Use `retrospective-preparation-v1` and hash canonical normalized evidence excluding preparation_hash. Bind sprint, scale, approved integration branch and head, exact range endpoints and bounded first-parent commits, story paths/contracts/Execution hashes and counters, integration/review evidence identities, full changed-path manifest, full-diff hash, changed-line count, selected lens, structural-selection paths/diff hash, AGENTS.md before hash, output path and null before-image.

Resolve each merged story's retained full integration OID from its Execution evidence, require every OID on the approved integration branch's bounded first-parent chain, order them by that chain, and use the first integration commit's first parent through the last integration commit. Treat squash/rebase integration OIDs as real integration events even when they are not Git merge commits. Missing, ambiguous, unreachable or non-first-parent evidence makes the preparation UNKNOWN.

Use argv-only Git reads with time and output limits, no fetch, shell, external diff or textconv. Cap stories, commits, changed paths and diff bytes. Define code-integrity as at most 1500 additions plus deletions; larger, binary, gitlink or type-changing ranges require architecture review. Large ranges require a nonempty caller-selected subset of actual changed structural paths plus the complete changed-path manifest. If the narrowed diff cannot fit the bound, return UNKNOWN rather than truncate.

Use `retrospective-submission-v1`, bound to preparation_hash, with exactly three IDs: recurrence, missing-context and ineffective-step. Each answer must cite retained evidence IDs, or use availability UNKNOWN only when the preparation records that evidence as unavailable. The ineffective-step decision is keep, drop or undecided; drop may be recorded only as an explicit user decision and never changes gates or policy.

Bind the cross-story review receipt to preparation_hash, exact lens and structural selection. Preserve every finding and derive the Markdown verdict as PASS, CONCERNS for unresolved minor-only findings, or FAIL for block/major findings. Every unresolved block/major finding and carried-over item must map to at least one explicit regular follow-up story in the next sprint; record the finding identity, severity, message and story IDs. Refuse recording when the mapping is absent.

Submission may contain a bounded unified AGENTS.md proposal against the retained before hash and an explicit accepted-additions subset. Render separate proposed and accepted sections. Never edit AGENTS.md in the retrospective transaction. Update operations.json so retrospective mutation paths contain only docs/retros/, removing its current AGENTS.md write claim.

Add a one-line versioned native metadata comment while keeping the upstream headings and path. A matching native record may return ALREADY_RECORDED idempotently. Any other existing regular Markdown remains compatible for shared inspection but is reported as imported/unverified and is never overwritten or represented as native authenticated evidence.

After T08 creates diagnostics.mjs, T10 should only change the native retrospective route from recovery.md to retrospective.md and test that upstream next_reference remains unchanged. Do not recreate T08 diagnostics or introduce a diagnostics-to-mutation dependency.

Tiny returns SKIPPED and cannot create a mandatory record. Small has no claim-block obligation; preserve the existing profile's optional retrospective wording and require an explicit sprint request if optional small-scale recording is supported. Standard, large and regulated select the oldest missing completed sprint.

test_priorities: Real Git fixtures with two or more stories, interleaved M/P/E/H commits, merge and squash/rebase integration events, and exact first-parent range endpoints.

Missing object, ambiguous Execution integration OID, nonancestor commit, side-branch commit, excessive history/diff and structural-selection UNKNOWN cases with byte-for-byte and Git-status nonmutation checks.
All three question IDs, evidence citation coverage, unavailable-evidence matching, stale preparation hashes and explicit keep/drop/undecided behavior.
Unresolved block/major and carried-over mappings to existing next-sprint stories; missing, malformed, same-sprint and nonregular follow-up stories must refuse without writing.
AGENTS.md proposal and accepted-subset validation, changed AGENTS before-image refusal, and proof that record never edits AGENTS.md.
Existing native record idempotence, conflicting/imported Markdown preservation, missing record, directory, FIFO and symlink handling.
Tiny/small/standard/large/regulated matrix, incomplete sprint refusal, explicit newer-sprint refusal and oldest-missing precedence.
Claim admission regression at the separately pinned current-pm seam, including no new claim while a standard-plus retrospective is owed and unaffected existing-claim resume.
Operation packaging: installed template/reference, standalone CLI help and JSON/exit behavior, operation map advertising only the implemented retrospective route and docs/retros mutation.
Diagnostics route switches to retrospective.md only after the reference exists and remains read-only.

retained_triage.instruction: Do not import unrelated T08/T09 or scanner findings into T10. The runtime should carry open findings only when they are actual evidence for the sprint being reviewed.
